record.question: Many people prefer to spend time alone because
options: they are good listeners and knowledgeable.
they love engaging in deep thoughts.
record.explanation: People who prefer spending time alone often do so because they enjoy engaging in deep thoughts, reflection, or introspection. This aligns with the common understanding that solitude can be sought for mental focus and personal contemplation rather than indicating instability or loneliness.
